copy.headline: It’s easier to bring your ideas to the forefront, and you’re less likely to slow things down just to maintain a superficial rapport.
copy.body: High extraversion will increase your energy to express yourself, enter the context, and drive interactions, while low agreeableness will make you less willing to give in to disagreements, inefficiencies, or unfairness. When the two are combined, your sense of advancement will be strong, but what others may receive may not only be clear, but also stressful.
copy.strength_sentence: This combination makes you more present when you need to break a situation, express your position and promote decision-making, and you will not be easily bogged down by vague consensus.
copy.risk_sentence: The price is: without rhythm control, you may push the other party into defense or confrontation before you have established enough understanding.
copy.action_hook: Your priority is to make sure the other person understands the goal before moving forward, rather than just making sure you expressed it clearly.
